items.transcript: This is the biggest story in AI right now. Anthropic, the company behind Claude, just went public and it's the biggest IPO in history. They raised $81 billion and when it started trading this morning under the ticker Ant, it opened at 111 bucks a share which for a minute there made it a $2 trillion company or in that window the sixth largest company on the planet. It's also the first of the big AI labs that you can buy stock in directly. So everybody's treating this like the test of whether AI is a bubble and OpenAI is planning to go public next year. So this is also setting the bar for them. But I actually think that today's price matters less than who ends up selling. [music] So normally insiders are locked up for about 6 months. But here employees can sell 10% of their shares starting today. Early investors start unlocking on December 15th. Now the founders and the biggest holders, they can't fully cash out for up to a year. But if the people who know this company best sell the second that they're allowed to, that's a pretty rough sign for this whole AI boom.
